meta.note: Food values matched row-for-row against the archived OWID CSV. Travel values were replaced with exact rows from the revised UK Government 2026 flat file. Source snapshots and SHA-256 hashes are stored under data/source_cache. UK travel values remain a jurisdiction proxy for UAE use.

travel.source_name: UK DESNZ/DEFRA Government GHG conversion factors for company reporting
travel.boundary: Operational or business-travel factors from the official 2026 flat file; excludes vehicle/infrastructure lifecycle and is not specific to Dubai fleets.

car.range_basis: 2026 small / average / large car, fuel unknown rows

bus.range_basis: 2026 London / average / non-London local bus rows; UK average loadings

metro_rail.range_basis: 2026 London Underground / light rail and tram / national rail rows; proxy only

walk.lifecycle_note: Operational emissions are zero; lifecycle (food energy, footwear, infrastructure) is not zero and is not estimated here.

bicycle.lifecycle_note: Operational emissions are zero; manufacturing and maintenance lifecycle is not zero and is not estimated here.

electric_car.unit: kg CO2e per vehicle-km = kWh/km x grid kg CO2e/kWh (both user-supplied)

food.source_name: Our World in Data, 'Environmental impacts of food' (data from Poore & Nemecek 2018, Science)
food.unit: kg CO2e per kg of product
food.boundary: Farm-to-retail life-cycle (land use change, farm, processing, transport, packaging, retail). Excludes consumer transport, storage and cooking. Global production-weighted averages.
food.uncertainty: Producer-level variation within a category is very large (published ranges span multiples of the mean). Ranges are not encoded in this release; see the source.
